text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaarrrrrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaah... ngh, haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――Tch! Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Haa!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Brian-senpai's running again... I wonder 
if she'll be at it until nighttime today 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—Let's get out of here. ...It hurts just 
watching this...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Something like that... feels like it might 
even destroy her original running style...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ……! —What is it, Ama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm poking my nose where it doesn't 
belong, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Her recent races were totally unlike her, 
weren't they? Both the Autumn Tenno Sho 
and the Japan Cup were night and day 
compared to how she used to run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still... if you're gonna keep struggling 
to the bitter end—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's throw down. One-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whether the sun sets or you drop from 
exhaustion, I'll stick with you until 
you're completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I can turn it more...! I can burn even 
hotter...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's spray all the fuel we've got 
straight into Maya's engine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll show a run so powerful that I won't 
lose to Brian-san... or anyone else, 
absolutely—!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

The year-end showdown, the Grand Prix 
race: the Arima Kinen.

However, completely out of place for such 
a glamorous venue, anxious faces could be 
seen scattered throughout the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day...! Do this for me, 
Narita Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Please... Just one more time, show me that 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Man, but isn't that actually really 
tough...? I mean, look at the recent Japan 
Cup—

“The fall of the ‘Monster.’ Even amid such 
whispers—”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Brian. Um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Heh. Ama-san, look at your face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
M-My face looks the same as always! 
...Jeez, honestly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"—Listen to me, okay? I know you're 
struggling, writhing, and agonizing 
through all of this."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Even so—no, that's precisely why!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not holding back, okay? I'm gonna 
overpower you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah. You wouldn't be you otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still parched. Still creaking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I cannot see the end of the darkness. 
...And yet. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm————not finished yet.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian-san...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But you know, Maya understands.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san's sparkle hasn't faded at all 
yet, has it—?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I can feel you screaming that you want to 
shine brighter and brighter――so that's 
why!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't take your eyes off Maya—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a Maya so insanely strong 
you won't be able to resist chasing after 
her—!

The Grand Prix race chosen to cap off this 
year: the Arima Kinen.

The preparations were cut close to the 
wire, but Marvelous Sunday seems to be in 
good shape.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (I can feel it—all kinds of emotions.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Expectation, anxiety, excitement, 
confusion— All these contradictory 
feelings, yet they blend together into a 
massive surge—)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Chaos. But I know this momentum can 
surely be turned into something super 
Marvelous――☆)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm off, Trainer☆★ Off to search for 
today's special Marvelous!
choice_data_list:
Now go forth with confidence and find 
it——!

text_block_list.text: The final race of the Classic Year begins—
